title: MDD Patients and Healthy Controls EEG Data
description: Resting-state (eyes-closed and eyes-open) and auditory oddball P300 task EEG recordings from patients with Major Depressive Disorder and healthy control participants. Data were recorded with a 19-channel 10-20 system at 256 Hz to support research on neurophysiological biomarkers of depression and on differences in attentional processing. This BIDS version was converted from the original figshare deposit.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 19-channel monopolar system placed according to the International 10-20 system, referenced to linked ears (A1+A2), sampled at 256 Hz. Hardware filters were a 0.5 Hz high-pass, 70 Hz low-pass and 50 Hz notch, with impedances below 5 kΩ. Conditions were eyes-closed rest, eyes-open rest, and an auditory oddball task with 80% standard and 20% target tones, in which participants mentally counted the targets. Artifact-free segments were selected from longer recordings.
